decision.reason: the cockpit read model and W3-05 to W3-07 runtime commands are not GREEN; canonical Task has a create-time priority field but no auditable reprioritize authority, while approval navigation can reuse canonical ActionProposal reads but needs exact navigation and readiness contracts

committedFacts.taskAuthority: canonical tenant-scoped Task and TaskRun routes exist
committedFacts.priority: Task priority is persisted at creation and exposed in snapshots, but no canonical reprioritize command, policy decision or priority-change Receipt was found
committedFacts.dispatch: no Cockpit dispatch command exists; W3-06 and W3-07 transport, decision, assignment and takeover authorities remain unimplemented
committedFacts.approval: canonical ActionProposal list, get, timeline and decide SDK operations exist, but the cockpit has no exact ApprovalNavigationTarget or server commandReadiness projection
committedFacts.readModel: CockpitReadModel is planned but W2-02 is not runtime GREEN

ownershipDecision.cockpit: read-only projection plus intent composer; it never owns Task, priority, Handoff, Responsibility, Approval or execution state
ownershipDecision.dispatch: DispatchIntentRevision binds exact TaskGraph, TaskRun, source and target Module installation, responsibility slot, current and requested assignee, readiness, Handoff policy, actor, cutoff and expected versions; confirmation invokes canonical services
ownershipDecision.priority: TaskPriorityDecisionRevision owns a reasoned, policy-constrained priority change with expected Task version and Receipt; client-side sorting is only a view preference
ownershipDecision.approvalNavigation: ApprovalNavigationTarget is an exact ref returned by the server read model; opening it is navigation only and destination authorization is rechecked
ownershipDecision.refresh: the cockpit applies no optimistic owner, priority or approval success; it refreshes canonical Receipt-backed state

requiredGreenEvidence: W2-02 CockpitReadModel stable cursor, cutoff, blocker refs and quantity conservation GREEN
W3-05 to W3-07 runtime commands and exact refs GREEN
dispatch intent Diff, impact, expected-version, idempotency, permission and Receipt tests
priority policy bounds, reason, CAS, replay, conflicting operators and immutable history tests
approval target exact ref, stale or unauthorized target, destination reauthorization and keyboard focus-return tests
no optimistic local owner, priority or approval mutation
org-org positive, dev-org isolation, refresh and restart reconstruction
